concept.title: Keep SMS shipment box handy
concept.shortdesc: This section describes the installation tools required.

conbody.p: This section describes the installation tools required.

You will receive a shipment box from the ADI team which will contain the along with some installation tools. Additionally, you will require a few other installation tools that do not come with the shipment box. See Unboxing SMS shipment box for details on all the installation tools required.
